facts.text: Harris Computer is a wholly-owned subsidiary of Constellation Software Inc., a publicly-traded company on the Toronto Stock Exchange.
facts.source_title: Constellation Software | Learn About Our Parent Company, CSI

facts.text: In July 1976, LEBS became the N. Harris Computer Corporation, with Nigel Harris becoming its first CEO. In 1996, twenty years after the founding, Nigel sold to Constellation Software Inc.
facts.source_title: Our Story | Explore the Story Behind Harris and How Our Organization Began

facts.text: In June 2024, Jeff Bender transitioned to Executive Chairman role after leading Harris for roughly two decades, and Jean Soucy became Group CEO on June 1, 2024.
facts.source_title: Harris operating group of constellation software announces executive changes

facts.text: Harris's growth is skewed to M&A over organic breakthroughs. External analysis indicates operational strain risk from rapid, multi-vertical acquisitions that must be integrated while maintaining customer experience across a decentralized portfolio.
facts.source_title: Harris Computer and the six-year goodbye

facts.text: Harris focuses on enabling teams to build mindset, systems, and capabilities to thrive in an era of intelligent work where AI enhances human potential. Harris Data Integrity Solutions offers an Intelligent MPI Triage Solution leveraging AI-driven logic paired with human intelligence.

Harris seeks mission-critical vertical software with low attrition as a core acquisition criterion. For 2026, Harris aims to sustain organic and acquired growth by nurturing relationships within their community of software users and builders.
Harris Computer had 25,607 employees in 2024, declining to 24,714 employees in 2025, a 1.8% decline year-over-year.

leadership.name: Nigel Harris
leadership.background: Founded N. Harris Computer Corporation in July 1976, sold company to Constellation Software in 1996.

leadership.name: Jeff Bender
leadership.background: Held CFO and COO roles before becoming CEO. Spent 7 years at Deloitte & Touche in technology business practice. Bachelor of Commerce from Carleton University. Member of Ontario Institute of Chartered Accountants. Transitioned to Executive Chairman in June 2024.

leadership.name: Jean Soucy
leadership.background: Joined Harris in 2012 as Public Sector Group President. Over 25 years software industry experience. Prior roles at DLGL, MediSolution, 20-20 Technologies, StormMaker, Nortel Networks, and RAND Worldwide. Bachelor of Mechanical Engineering from Ecole Polytechnique, MBA from Concordia University.
